Claim 1 (Currently Amended): A belly pan for a motor vehicle, comprising: a body panel having a forward section constructed from an open rib structure with a first corner buttress and a second corner buttress; and an aero cover carried on said body panel and spanning said open rib structure.

Claim 15 (Currently Amended): A belly pan for a motor vehicle, comprising: a body panel having first and second corner buttresses, a first open rib structure reinforcing said first corner buttress and a second open rib structure reinforcing said second corner buttress; a first aero cover spanning and closing said first open rib structure; and a second aero cover spanning and closing said second open rib structure, wherein said first open rib structure includes a first fore-aft rib and a first plurality of transverse ribs projecting from opposed sides of said first fore-aft rib, and said second open rib structure includes a second fore-aft rib and a second plurality of transverse ribs projecting from opposed sides of said second fore-aft rib.
